name: Columbus AFB
description: Home of the 14th Flying Training Wing. Columbus AFB is a specialized undergraduate pilot training installation, training hundreds of pilots annually in the T-6 Texan II and T-38 Talon.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate (East Gate)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 access. Visitor passes issued here when VCC is closed. Trusted Traveler program 0600-2200.

gates.name: South Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1800; closed weekends and federal holidays

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 99)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. REAL ID required. Pre-registration available via email to VCC.
gates.address: 108 Simler Blvd, Bldg 99, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: Event Center (Lunch Buffet)
resources.description: No traditional DFAC; primary dining at Event Center lunch buffet, Strike Zone Grill, Coffee House, and Crosswinds Club venues.
resources.hours: Tue-Thu Lunch 1100-1300; special events by request

resources.name: Columbus Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court.
resources.address: Bldg 160, 323 Simler Blvd, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: Columbus AFB Commissary
resources.address: 323 Simler Blvd, Bldg 160-B, Columbus AFB, MS 39705

resources.name: Triangle Federal Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with ATM.
resources.address: 325 Simler Blvd, Suite 1, Bldg 160, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: 14th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, flight medicine, and TRICARE services. No emergency department on base.

resources.name: Fitness Center (Bldg 704)
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and Alpha Warrior Tent. 24/7 access available after registration.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0500-2300; 24/7 access by request after CAC registration at front desk

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management for student pilots and permanent party.

resources.name: Magnolia Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. Front desk for arrivals.
resources.address: Bldg 956, 179 Webb St, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, and family programs.
resources.address: Bldg 1114, 166 C Circle, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: 14th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Facility hours listed on FSS website

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, and personnel actions.

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation / FamCamp
resources.description: Equipment rental, FamCamp, paintball, skeet/trap range, Independence Pool, and Venture 360 activity center.

resources.name: Crosswinds DGC @ Venture 360
resources.description: 18-hole disc golf course on the former golf course site. Free to play; download UDisc app for course map.
resources.hours: Open year-round; may close during special events

resources.name: Strike Zone Bowling Center
resources.description: Bowling with Strike Zone Grill, golf simulator, and event packages.
resources.address: 575 Harpe Blvd, Bldg 736, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes, DBIDS vetting, and base access. REAL ID required.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; after-hours passes at Main Gate
resources.address: 108 Simler Blvd, Bldg 99, Columbus AFB, MS 39710

Doors open at 1730 and the show starts at 1800! This show is a family-friendly event, and there will be FREE Pizza while supplies last!

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining squadron upon arrival. Contact Magnolia Inn (662-434-2548) for after-hours lodging. Visit MPF within required timelines.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Magnolia Inn for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (662-434-5218) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through privatized housing office.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC at 662-434-2790 if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 14 FSS, M&FRC, and official Columbus sites for in-processing and pilot training support.
